newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent marked lower as NYMEX falls after API.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent marked lower as NYMEX falls after API.

text.p: Brent crude futures were marked lower on SIMEX on Wednesday after a bearish set of stock data from the United States overnight.
July Brent was untraded at midday but was quoted at $18.60/$18.78 per barrel, keeping track of a fall in NYMEX crudes in after-hours trading.
London July Brent fell 62 cents overnight to $18.90.
July NYMEX on ACCESS was last traded in Asia at $20.12 per barrel, extending New York's 65-cent losses by a further 21 cents.
The overnight weakness was attributed to a technical sell off and the last hurdle being cleared in an extension to Iraq's oil-for-food deal.
The United States confirmed overnight it would support a six month renewal of the $2 billion deal.
But API data after the close of New York floor trading added a further bearish pall.
It showed sharp builds in crude and products, record output of gasoline and high refinery utilisation.
